text.id: Dinda nyubit layar, ngegedein fotonya. Rambut setengah diiket. Jaket hijau tentara yang kegedean. Headphone di leher. "Itu Kak Sekar," katanya. "Itu jaketnya."
text.en: Dinda pinches the screen, zooming in. Hair tied half up. An oversized army-green jacket. Headphones round her neck. "That's Sekar," she says. "That's her jacket."

text.id: Di belakangnya ada haluan kapal kayu biru-putih. Ada nama di haluannya, "SRI REJ", terus sisanya ketutup ban bekas. Di bawahnya, lebih kecil, "No. 14", terus ketutup ban yang sama.
text.en: Behind her is the bow of a blue and white wooden boat. There's a name on it, "SRI REJ", then an old tire hides the rest. Under it, smaller, "No. 14", hidden by the same tire.

text.id: Sekar nggak bales foto ini. Sekar selalu bales. Mungkin dia lagi nggak bisa. Atau dia nggak mau ada yang tahu dia di sana.
text.en: Sekar didn't reply to this photo. Sekar always replies. Maybe she couldn't. Or she didn't want anyone to know she was there.
